hero.title: Turn your receivables into cash.
hero.description: Structure your collection process, automate reminders, manage payment plans and disputes, and maintain clear visibility of every receivable until settlement.
hero.reassurance: Enterprise Solution • Integrates with Existing Systems • Secure • Scalable
hero.imageAlt: Collection officer working on a multi-screen management system

journey.title: From first overdue to settlement, every step is controlled.
journey.description: The solution covers the entire collection cycle, from receivable import to bank reconciliation.

steps.title: Import
steps.description: Import invoices and buyers from existing systems.

steps.title: Analysis
steps.description: Identify overdue receivables, aging and prioritization.

steps.title: Reminders
steps.description: Automated sending of reminders by email and SMS.

overview.title: All your receivables in a single view.
overview.description: Centralize buyer, invoice and receivable information to provide your teams with a complete and reliable overview.

importBuyers.title: Buyer Import
importBuyers.description: Synchronize with existing systems to retrieve buyers with outstanding receivables.

importInvoices.title: Invoice Import
importInvoices.description: Automatic import of unpaid invoices from billing systems or business applications.

dueDateTracking.title: Due Date Tracking
dueDateTracking.description: Clear visualization of invoices approaching due date and overdue invoices.

statusTracking.title: Receivable Status
statusTracking.description: Track each receivable by status: unpaid, partially paid, under dispute, under payment plan, or settled.

aging.title: Aging Analysis
aging.description: Distribution of receivables by age: not due, 1-30 days, 31-60 days, 61-90 days, and 90+ days.

overview.businessRule: Invoices covered by an active payment plan do not continue through the standard automated reminder workflow.

workflow.title: The right reminder, at the right time, on the right channel.
workflow.description: Configure collection scenarios adapted to your business rules, buyer segments and communication channels.

timeline.title: Every action is recorded, every case is traceable.
timeline.description: The complete history of collection interactions and actions remains available for every receivable and every buyer.

paymentPlan.title: Turn a payment promise into a tracked installment plan.
paymentPlan.description: Create, validate and track flexible payment plans adapted to each buyer's situation.

scenarioA.title: Number of Months
scenarioA.description: Define the number of months and the system automatically calculates installments.

scenarioB.title: Fixed Installment Amount
scenarioB.description: Define the desired installment amount and the system determines the number of installments.

paymentNotifications.title: The buyer is informed at every stage of the plan.

disputes.title: Separate genuine delays from disputes that need resolution.
disputes.description: Identify, document and resolve disputes while maintaining a complete history of associated collection actions.
disputes.note: Collection actions automatically adapt when an invoice is under dispute.

buyer360.title: One buyer, the full story.
buyer360.description: Visualize the entire relationship with a buyer from a single screen: identity, financial situation, history and risk level.

risk.title: Prioritize your collection actions.
risk.description: The solution identifies buyers requiring priority attention based on objective criteria from payment history.
risk.note: Risk analysis is based on business rules and payment history, not autonomous decisions.

preLitigation.title: From amicable collection to formal notice.
preLitigation.description: Structure the transition from friendly reminders to pre-litigation with complete action tracking.

reporting.title: Drive your collections with data.
reporting.description: Track key performance indicators of your collection process from a dedicated dashboard.

reports.title: Reports adapted to each need.
reports.description: Generate detailed reports according to your criteria and export results in the appropriate format.

types.name: Unpaid Invoices
types.description: Detailed overview of invoices awaiting payment.

types.name: Payment Plans
types.description: Current payment plans and their execution.

types.name: Disputes
types.description: Open and resolved disputes with their history.

types.name: Collections
types.description: Amounts collected over a selected period.

types.name: Aging
types.description: Distribution of receivables by age of delay.

integrations.title: Connected to your information system.
integrations.description: The solution integrates with existing systems to ensure reliable data flow between billing, banking and communication tools.

invoicing.title: Billing / ERP
invoicing.description: Import buyers, invoices, due dates and payments from existing systems.

banking.title: Banking Systems
banking.description: Retrieve and synchronize payment information when supported.

reconciliation.title: Bank Reconciliation
reconciliation.description: Identify payments associated with receivables to accelerate closure.

apps.title: Business Applications
apps.description: Integration through the architecture supported by the solution.

security.title: Protected financial data.
security.description: The solution integrates access controls, audit trails and protection measures tailored to sensitive financial information.

items.title: Role-based Access
items.description: Collection manager, administrator, financial direction: each role sees only what is relevant to them.

items.title: Access Control
items.description: Administrator access, manager access and strict control of financial information.

items.title: Traceability
items.description: Complete history of actions, modifications and interventions on every case.

items.title: Secure Integrations
items.description: Secure connection to billing, banking and communication systems.

security.note: Regulatory compliance is considered during design. Specific certifications are presented only when confirmed by the project.

customWorkflow.title: A collection process tailored to your organization.
customWorkflow.description: Configure the steps and reminder rules according to your business needs, buyer segments and communication channels.

buyerPortal.title: A dedicated space for your buyers.
buyerPortal.description: Offer your buyers a portal to view their invoices, payment plans and payment history.

case1.title: Reschedule multiple invoices over several months

case2.title: Set a fixed amount per installment

cta.title: Structure your collections. Accelerate your cash flow.
cta.description: Discover how the solution can integrate with your existing environment and structure your entire collection process.
